name: send-core-playwright-framework
description: Playwright framework for the automation of SEND

scripts.pretest: npx eslint --config src/linters/.eslintrc.js src --fix && prettier --config src/linters/prettierrc.yml src --write
scripts.test:dev:clean: npm run clean:allure && cross-env NODE_ENV=dev npx playwright test || echo 'Test run has failures. Check the report for details.'
scripts.allure:generate: npm run allure:copy:history && allure generate allure-results --clean
scripts.test:dev:allure: npm run pretest && npm-run-all --continue-on-error -s test:dev:clean allure:generate
scripts.test:dev:allure:open: npm run pretest && npm-run-all --continue-on-error -s test:dev:clean allure:generate allure:open
scripts.test:dev:allure:xray: npm-run-all --continue-on-error -s test:dev:clean && npm run clean-xray && npm run xray:upload

author: SEND TECHNOLOGY
